name: Rainforest Alliance
mission: The Rainforest Alliance works to encourage better on-the-ground forestry practices by rewarding businesses, communities and governments that meet standards for sustainability.
theoryOfChange: The Rainforest Alliance explicitly states that it uses a Theory of Change approach to design projects and programs, including carefully developed indicators to track outcomes and impacts. Their 'Theory of Change for the 2020 Certification Program' presents a results chain logic, detailing outputs, short-term outcomes, intermediate outcomes, long-term outcomes, and impacts. This framework is used for internal monitoring and evaluation of their certification program and to communicate program impacts to external stakeholders. The Theory of Change reflects a 'Reimagining Certification approach' that emphasizes continuous improvement, contextualization of requirements, shared responsibility, and data-driven assessment processes.

rich_narrative.summary: The Rainforest Alliance works to protect global ecosystems by helping businesses and rural communities adopt sustainable land-use practices <cite id="5">across environmental hotspots</cite>. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="1">$100,221,940 in total revenue</cite> to advance its forestry and agricultural programs. The group maintains strong operational efficiency, directing an <cite id="6">84.3% program expense ratio</cite> toward field initiatives and capacity building. Third-party evaluators recognize this governance, earning the charity <cite id="6">a 91/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> alongside a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid. While the organization delivers cost-effective programs in several Muslim-majority regions such as Côte d'Ivoire and Indonesia, it operates as a secular environmental group without dedicated faith-based programming or formal sadaqah tracking frameworks.
